Description:
Daily standup for Project Foxglove (curriculum review + accreditation packet).

Format:
- Round-robin, everyone: yesterday / today / blockers
- Elena: survey response counts
- Sana: syllabus collection status
- Mariam: assessment rubric drafts
- Ilse: library + IR data pulls
- Maeve: faculty interview scheduling
- Delia: packet formatting
- GAs: transcription progress
- Open floor at end

Notes:
Cameras on if remote.
GAs only need to report on transcription, but please stay for the full call in case something comes up.
If you have nothing new, still give an update.
Blockers that need more than a minute: we'll sort them at the end, so hold them.
Dana will recap the accreditation timeline each day.

Running notes doc linked in attachments. Update before 9 if you can.

Going? Yes / No / Maybe"},{"spec_id":"spec_0754","text":"Subject: Spring All-Staff Get-Together – Thursday at 2pm, Commons Room

Hey folks,

It's that time again. Let's pull up some chairs Thursday from 2:00 to 3:00 in the Commons Room (Teams link below for anybody out at the field offices). This one's for all 133 of us, so grab a coffee and come on by.

Here's what's on the plate:

1. Budget update – Tess Abernathy will walk through where we landed on next year's numbers. Short version: no layoffs, modest raises, details in her slides.
2. The Delacroix contract – Olu Delacroix's team signed off last week. Lucia Szabo will cover the start date and which departments will see new crews around the courthouse.
3. Benefits enrollment – Yara Hakimi will remind everybody open enrollment runs through the end of the month and show where the forms live.
4. New parking setup – Sam Haddad will go over the new lot assignments starting May 1. Maps are coming by email too.
5. Shout-outs – Paloma Ferraro has a few kind words for the snow crew who kept roads open all winter.

I'll wrap up with a quick word from me and we'll call it a day.

Each presenter will send their slides around afterward, so no need to scribble notes. If you've got a question, you can drop it in the Teams chat, though honestly most of this is a heads-up so nobody's caught off guard.

Appreciate y'all. See you Thursday.

Leon
County Administrator's Office
Pinepath County"},{"spec_id":"spec_0755","text":"@channel Anchor GTM pivot readout + Q&A, 30min Tues 9am ET (or PT?)"}]}
